fieldMarks: Small (about 160 g) with short round ears and no visible tail
Pale collar patch on nape and shoulders
Creamy-buff patch over the facial gland separates it from American pika
behavior: Call is a single piercing 'ank' or 'ink' audible for hundreds of yards
Gathers vegetation into haypiles under rocks for winter; may steal from neighbours
habitat: Alpine and subalpine talus slopes and rock slides, favouring southwest-facing slopes.
range: Central and southeastern Alaska, Yukon-Tanana uplands, Richardson Mountains (Yukon/NWT) and northwestern British Columbia.

lookalikes.name: American pika
lookalikes.howToTell: Lacks the collar and buff facial-gland patch (source says differs mainly in fur colouration).
